pressure_hypothesis.title: Native-labeled source references mix contract and host-provider roles
pressure_hypothesis.basis: Schema /2 named a mixed role list native implementation references while it included language_contract, compiler_support, and host_runtime_provider records. Role tags aid inspection, but the container name alone can imply ownership or displacement not established by the source evidence.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Use a role-neutral source-reference field and expose implementation ownership and native-language displacement explicitly as not-established until independent completeness and behavior evidence exists.

functional ownership or completeness by source role
